_comment_top: MCP hooks configuration template for harness agents. Each harness (jcode, codex, forge) has its own preferred location and schema; see _comment_install_paths below.
_comment_version: v1.0 — initial template, 2026-10-12, instinct shared-integration-kit branch.
_comment_license: Same as parent repo (PhenoShared — operator-confirmed MIT/Apache dual).

hooks.command: bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"gh repo delete"*|*"git push --force"*|*"git reset --hard"*) echo "[mcp-hook] BLOCKED destructive command: $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" >&2; exit 2;; esac'
hooks._intent: Block destructive git/gh commands. Adjust the case patterns to match your policy.
Log edit operations for audit. Set CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH or equivalent.

hooks.command: if command -v lefthook >/dev/null 2>&1; then lefthook run pre-commit || echo '[mcp-hook] lefthook pre-commit failed (continuing)'; else echo '[mcp-hook] lefthook not installed; skipping'; fi
hooks._intent: Auto-run lefthook after edits to catch fmt/lint issues immediately.

hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Agent event" with title "jcode" subtitle "$CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION_TYPE"' 2>/dev/null || echo "[mcp-hook] notification: $CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION_TYPE"
hooks._intent: Desktop notification on harness events. macOS uses osascript; on Linux use notify-send.

_comment_variables.$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT: Tool input as a string (may be JSON-encoded).
_comment_variables.$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH: File path when tool is Edit/Write/MultiEdit.
_comment_variables.$CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION_TYPE: Type of harness notification (auth, permission_prompt, idle, etc.).
_comment_variables._note: Variable names are conventions; each harness may use different names. Test before relying on them.
